pet_notes: Original chibi anime cat-girl named Nicole. Preserve long pastel-pink hair with soft bangs and curled side locks, large pink cat ears with white inner fur, bright aqua-blue eyes, blue ribbon bows with a small heart ornament, black collar with a large gold bell, blue-and-white maid-inspired sailor dress with white scalloped collar, blue chest bow, lavender puff sleeves, and pink cross-body strap. Compact full-body 2.5-head chibi proportions, cheerful gentle personality. The drink cup and cat-shaped shoulder bag are optional scene props and should not be added to states unless naturally required. No text, logos, scenery, or extra characters.
